about_the_game:
About The Game

In a world where unemployment and inflation rise relentlessly, Micheal Jilien—a Vietnamese medical graduate from Florida—has been struggling for nearly a year to find work. When an unexpected interview invitation arrives from a company in the outskirts, hope returns. But what awaits her there is far from opportunity—it’s the beginning of a dark conspiracy.

Step into Micheal’s shoes as she ventures into the unknown, uncovering secrets buried deep beneath the surface. Every step forward takes you closer to the truth… and deeper into danger.

Gameplay Features

Single-player Action Platformer – Engage in fast-paced shooting and platforming while navigating treacherous environments.

Puzzle & Exploration – Solve intricate puzzles and discover hidden paths that test both your mind and reflexes.

Narrative-Driven Experience – Pay attention to every conversation. Missing a clue could make your journey much harder.

Dark & Atmospheric Setting – Explore the depths of an underground technological disaster where danger lurks in every shadow.

Tension & Curiosity Combined – A gloomy, suspense-filled environment keeps you on edge as you uncover the mystery.

Are you ready to uncover the truth behind the call?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-540 or AMD Phenom II X4 965
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTS 250 or Radeon HD 5770
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Discrete Graphics Card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Win10
  • Processor: i3-6100
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 730
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Discrete Graphics Card

short_description: Micheal Jillien, a Vietnamese medical graduate, accepts a job interview in the suburbs. But behind it lies a deadly plot. Can you help her survive and escape the trap?
supported_languages:
English*, Vietnamese
*languages with full audio support
